title.zh: 在布拉干省San Jose Del Monte市设立陆运署（LTO）卫星办公室并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a Satellite Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in San Jose Del Monte City, Province of Bulacan and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a Satellite Office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in San Jose Del Monte City, Province of Bulacan and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập một Văn phòng vệ tinh Land Transportation Office tại Tỉnh Bulacan, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งสำนักงานดาวเทียม Land Transportation Office ในจังหวัด Bulacan และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Kantor Satelit Land Transportation Office di Provinsi Bulacan, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan sebuah Pejabat Satelit Land Transportation Office di Wilayah Bulacan, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11432_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established a satellite office of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) in the, City of San Jose Del Monte, Province of Bulacan.

The Secretary of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the LTO Satellite Office in San Jose Del Monte City in the Province of Bulacan, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
